features.description: Native installer via curl (macOS/Linux) or PowerShell (Windows), plus `claude update`, `claude install <version>`, release channels, and `claude doctor` for install diagnostics.

Browser OAuth sign-in with Claude Pro/Max/Ultra, Teams/Enterprise, or Claude Console; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; cloud-provider env vars (Bedrock, Google Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry) or 3rd-party-platform wizard; Claude apps gateway SSO; multi-account via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; /logout.
`claude setup-token` prints a long-lived OAuth token for CI/scripts; `claude auth login|logout|status` manage credentials from the shell, with `--sso` and `--email` flags.

Sessions save continuously as local JSONL transcripts; resume via `claude --continue`, `claude --resume <id|name|path>`, `--from-pr <number>` for PR-linked sessions, and the `/resume` picker with search, preview, and worktree/project filters.
Name a session at launch (`claude -n <name>`), in-session (`/rename`), or from the picker (Ctrl+R); unnamed sessions get AI-generated titles usable as resume handles.
`/branch` copies the conversation and switches you into the copy; `--fork-session` forks on resume; `/fork` copies the conversation into a separate background session.

`/clear` starts a fresh session, `/compact [instructions]` summarizes history to free context, `/autocompact` sets the auto-compaction window, and `/context` visualizes what's consuming the context window.
Every prompt creates an automatic file-edit checkpoint; `/rewind` (aliases `/undo`, double-Esc) restores code and/or conversation to any earlier point, or summarizes from/up to a message.
`/export` renders the conversation to clipboard or a file; scripts can capture `claude -p --output-format json` or read the transcript path from hooks/status-line input.

`claude agents` opens agent view to dispatch and monitor background sessions; `/background` (alias `/bg`) detaches the current session; `claude attach|stop|logs|rm|respawn` manage them from the shell; `/tasks` lists in-session background work.
Type while Claude works to queue follow-ups; Ctrl+Enter sends them immediately; Esc interrupts and redirects mid-turn while keeping completed work.
Ctrl+B backgrounds running shell commands and agents; `/bashes`/`/tasks` show running and finished background work.
Ctrl+T toggles Claude's live to-do checklist in the status area.
`/btw [question]` asks a side question about the session without adding it to the conversation Claude sees.
Automatic one-line recap after you've been away, plus `/recap` on demand.
`/rate-limit-options` offers wait-and-auto-continue when a claude.ai limit resets, adding usage credits, or upgrading the plan.
Ctrl+O toggles a detailed transcript view with tool usage, timestamps, the model per message, and expanded collapsed calls.
Clipboard image paste (Ctrl+V) with positional [Image #N] chips, `@` file-path autocomplete, `:emoji:` shortcodes, spell-check, draft stash (Ctrl+S), and reverse history search (Ctrl+R).
Multiline input via Shift+Enter/\+Enter/Ctrl+J, Vim editing mode via /config, and Ctrl+G to compose prompts in your $EDITOR; /terminal-setup fixes Shift+Enter in common terminals.
Shift+Tab cycles Manual (default), acceptEdits, plan, and — where available — auto, dontAsk, and bypassPermissions; each mode sets what Claude runs without asking.
`/plan [description]` or plan permission mode makes Claude research read-only, then present a plan via ExitPlanMode for your approval before edits; accepting a plan titles the session.
Permission mode where a background classifier plus trust rules let everything run without prompts; `/auto-mode-setup` drafts trusted repo/bucket/domain entries and `/permissions` reviews denials.
Allow/ask/deny rules per tool (e.g. `Bash(git push:*)`) in settings files, the `/permissions` dialog, and `--allowedTools`/`--disallowedTools` flags; deny rules apply in every mode.
First-run workspace-trust dialogs gate a repo's config; `/add-dir` grants file access to more directories; `/cd` moves the session to a new directory.
Built-in OS-level sandbox (macOS Seatbelt, Linux/WSL2 Landlock) restricts shell-command filesystem and network access; `/sandbox` toggles it; auto-allow mode pre-approves sandboxed commands.
Beyond the Bash sandbox: a sandbox runtime, dev containers, custom Docker containers, VMs, or cloud sessions, with org-wide enforcement.
Writes to protected paths and rm-style critical-path removals always prompt — even in bypassPermissions — with optional blocks on reads/writes outside working directories.

File tools (Read, Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Glob, Grep), Bash and PowerShell, WebFetch and WebSearch, Task (subagents), AskUserQuestion, EnterWorktree, Monitor, LSP, Agent, SendFeedback, EndConversation.
Permission prompts offer once/session/always answers, and Tab opens a comment field so your reasoning travels with the decision.

`/model` picker or Option/Alt+P switches models using aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, best, opusplan, sonnet[1m]/opus[1m] 1M-context variants); `--model` flag; custom model options and gateway model discovery.
`/effort` sets adaptive-reasoning effort (low→xhigh, max); `ultracode` makes Claude plan a dynamic workflow for substantive tasks; the `ultrathink` keyword deepens one turn's reasoning.
Option/Alt+T toggles extended thinking per session; current models use adaptive reasoning where effort level is the primary thinking control.
`/fast` toggles a high-speed configuration (up to 2.5x faster) for supported Opus/Fable models at higher token cost.
`/advisor [model]` pairs a stronger advisor model that Claude consults at key moments — before committing to an approach, when stuck, or before declaring done.
Experimental mode (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1) where Claude writes JavaScript that performs several tool calls in a single step.

Persistent instruction files at managed/org, user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project (./CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md), and local (CLAUDE.local.md) scopes, with `@path` imports, on-demand nested loading, `/init` generation, and the `/memory` editor.
Claude Code can read a repository's AGENTS.md files in place of CLAUDE.md.
Claude writes MEMORY.md learnings automatically from your corrections; the first 200 lines or 25KB load every session; subagents can keep their own.
`.claude/rules/` markdown rules with `paths:` frontmatter load only when Claude works with matching files.

Bundled skills (/doctor, /code-review, /batch, /loop, /claude-api, /run, /verify, /debug, /design, /slides) plus custom skills in .claude/skills, invoked as slash commands or matched by description; `/skills` manages visibility and context cost.

40+ lifecycle events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, SubagentStart, PreCompact, Stop, WorktreeCreate, SessionEnd, Elicitation, …) run shell commands, HTTP calls, prompts, or MCP tools; `/hooks` menu to inspect them.

`claude mcp add` / `--mcp-config` connects stdio and HTTP/SSE MCP servers with OAuth (`claude mcp login`), user/project/local scopes, the `/mcp` manager, MCP tool search, prompts as commands, and elicitation responses.
Claude Code can expose itself as an MCP server to other clients.

`/plugin` installs plugins (bundles of skills, hooks, agents, MCP servers) from Anthropic or community marketplaces; `/reload-plugins` applies changes without restarting; mods add panes and UI; plugin evals gate quality.
A language-server plugin gives Claude live type-error diagnostics after edits and symbol navigation, like an editor's LSP.

Built-in read-only Explore/Plan subagents plus custom agents in .claude/agents (model, tools, effort, memory frontmatter); run in foreground or background; `/subtask` forks the conversation into a background subagent that reports back.
JavaScript scripts Claude writes to orchestrate many subagents at once (`/batch` for parallel PR-producing changes, `/deep-research`, `/simplify`); `/workflows` watches, pauses, and resumes runs.
Experimental (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1): a lead session coordinates teammate sessions with shared tasks, inter-agent messaging, and centralized management.
Claude can list (`/list-agents`) and message your other local, cloud, or teammate sessions — e.g. warn a session about a breaking change.
`/output-style` switches among Default, Proactive (starts work without routine questions), Concise, Explanatory (adds Insight blocks), and Learning, or a custom markdown style.
`/statusline` configures a custom bottom bar: your shell script receives JSON session data and prints context usage, cost, git status, etc.
A keybindings configuration file remaps shortcuts across prompt, transcript viewer, dialogs, and text fields.
`/theme` offers light/dark/auto, colorblind-safe, and ANSI themes plus custom themes from ~/.claude/themes; `/color` sets the prompt-bar color.
`/tui fullscreen` enables a flicker-free alt-screen renderer with mouse support, conversation search, and a diff panel.
`/voice` enables hold-to-record or tap-to-record prompt dictation with language selection and key rebinding.
Screen-reader mode for VoiceOver/NVDA, magnifier, reduced-motion, and colorblind-friendly theme settings.
Terminal bell/notification when Claude finishes, tmux configuration, theme matching, and Option-as-Meta setup for macOS shortcuts.
`claude-cli://` URLs open Claude Code in the right repo with a prefilled prompt from runbooks, alerts, or dashboards.
Claude stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests (via gh); `/diff` reviews working-tree changes including Claude's edits.
`claude --worktree` runs a session in an isolated git worktree; subagents can be isolated per-worktree; non-git VCS supported via WorktreeCreate hooks.
`/code-review [level] [pr#|branch|path]` reviews your diff or a PR for correctness bugs at chosen effort levels, with `--fix` to apply findings and `--comment` to post them to GitHub/GitLab.
`/code-review ultra` runs a deep multi-agent review in a cloud sandbox, verifies findings, and can post them to the PR.
Org-level automatic review of GitHub pull requests via the Claude GitHub App: inline verified findings, `@claude review` requests, and REVIEW.md customization.
`/security-review` analyzes the branch's diff for injection, auth, and data-exposure risks; the Claude Security plugin scans codebases and turns findings into patches.
The claude-code-action runs Claude Code in CI workflows: @claude mentions implement changes and push commits, and prompts fire on any GitHub event.
GitLab-maintained beta integration for running Claude Code inside GitLab pipelines.

claude.ai/code runs sessions on cloud infrastructure from browser, phone, desktop, or terminal (`claude --cloud` to submit, `/teleport` to pull one into your terminal); GitHub-connected repos and configurable cloud environments.
`/autofix-pr [prompt]` spawns a cloud session that watches the branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers comment.
Public beta: one ongoing conversation where Claude coordinates a stream of tasks as parallel cloud (or Remote Control) threads sharing repositories, instructions, and memory.
`/remote-control` connects claude.ai/code or the Claude iOS/Android app to the session running on your machine — full local environment, synced across devices, images/files from your phone.
The Claude iOS/Android app starts, monitors, and steers cloud sessions, Projects, Remote-Control sessions, and Desktop Dispatch.

The Claude Desktop Code tab: parallel sessions with git isolation, drag-and-drop panes, integrated terminal and file editor, side chats, computer use, Dispatch from phone, visual diff review, app previews, PR monitoring, connectors, iOS simulator pane.
Native panel with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, conversation resume, background work, Jupyter support, a built-in IDE MCP server, and a Claude Code terminal.
Works in IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm and other JetBrains IDEs with interactive diff viewing and selection-context sharing; `/ide` connects CLI sessions to the IDE.
`claude --chrome` connects the session to your Chrome browser (visible, logged-in) to test web apps, fill forms, read console logs, and extract data.
macOS research preview: Claude opens apps, clicks, types, and screenshots your screen to test native apps and GUI-only tools from the terminal.
Claude Tag brings Claude into Slack channels for coding tasks; the legacy Slack app answers @claude mentions from Pro/Max/Ultra accounts.

`claude -p` runs non-interactively with `--allowedTools`, `--permission-mode`, `--output-format json|stream-json`, `--max-turns`, `--json-schema` structured output, and `--bare` fast-start mode for CI.
TypeScript and Python SDKs build custom agents on Claude Code's tools, agent loop, hooks, skills, sessions, subagents, MCP, and approvals — with streaming and structured outputs.
`/loop [interval] [prompt]` re-runs a prompt in-session (self-paced, or a loop.md default), one-time reminders, and cron expressions.
`/schedule` creates cloud tasks (formerly routines) that run on a schedule, on API calls, or on GitHub events.
`/goal <condition>` keeps Claude working across turns until the condition is met, a model judges it impossible, or you clear it.
Research preview: MCP servers push webhooks, alerts, and chat messages into your running session, and Claude can reply back through the channel.

Sessions publish live interactive pages to claude.ai to keep private, share, or make public — with comment auto-replies, connector data, and file downloads; `/design`, `/slides`, `/dataviz` produce artifacts.
`/usage` (aliases /cost, /stats) shows session cost and plan-limit breakdowns; usage credits and team spend limits; `/insights` generates an HTML report of your sessions.
OTel export of metrics, events, and traces; org-wide usage analytics dashboard and spend monitoring.
`/doctor` setup checkup with fixes, `/doctor prompt-audit` for stale instructions, `/debug` session logging, `/fewer-permission-prompts` allowlist builder, `claude doctor` from the shell.
`/import codex|gemini|cursor` brings instruction files, MCP servers, commands, subagents, and skills from other coding agents into Claude Code.

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL routes Claude Code through an organization's LLM gateway; cloud providers (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS) are configured via env vars or setup wizards.
